The machine description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates vineyard areas in thousands of hectares for different countries over the period 2013–2022.
The machine description does not mention that the values for each country remain constant over the years, as visible in the chart.
The machine description does not highlight that Spain has the highest values (around 950 thousand hectares) and Argentina has the lowest values (around 200 thousand hectares).
